_note: Lifetime near-miss / 'Ausweichen' achievements (src/constants.js DODGE_ACHIEVEMENTS) - a near-miss is wall clearance < PR*2.0, see update.js's near-miss check. Same array shape as ach_translations_flight.json: [title, post-earned description, pre-earned description]. Play Console has ONE description field - use the pre-earned string there. Icons: achievement-icons/dodge_100.png, dodge_1000.png (512x512 RGB, no alpha, not yet generated). Points: 15/30 - same escalation as flight_1min/flight_2min, since both are skill-driven (not pure grind) 2-tier achievements. Hidden: No. Incremental: No.
